name: Digital Surface Extraction via Khalimsky Space
aliases: Digital Surface Extraction via Khalimsky Space and Surfel Adjacency
Dual surface to the digital boundary
Marching-cube like surface extracted using the combinatorial manifold structure of digital surfaces
definition: A method to extract a boundary surface from a digital image by constructing a Khalimsky space, defining a digital set based on intensity thresholds, and scanning the space to identify surfels (surface elements) using a specific adjacency rule (interior or exterior).
